summary: Frontend-only testing of saved templates (IndexedDB), text style (bold/italic/alignment) and front text (left/over). Backend was skipped as requested. All 8 requested scenarios PASS, with 0 page errors. (1) After turning on the tag switch, all testids are present for item-0-front-txt and item-0-back-txt: textarea, font, color, font-upload, font-input, bold, italic, align-left/center/right, plus pos-left/pos-over on the front. Duplex turns on automatically. (2) Pixel analysis of the sheet-preview-front image (425x118 tile). With pos-left the text is only in the left half (dark px left=2160, right=0) and the red image is intact. With pos-over the text is only in the right half (x 230-409) on top of the image (red px dropped 25016 to 22233). (3) Alignment shifts the text bbox: front left x 9-186, center 19-196, right 28-205 in the 0-212 zone. Back left 226-411, right 227-412 (right edge 412 of 425). Bold roughly doubles the ink (2160 to 4148 front, 1387 to 2899 back). Italic changes the render. Every change produces a new data URL. The toggle buttons show the active pink state. (4) Saving with an empty name gives the toast 'Dai un nome al modello'. A valid name gives the toast 'Modello "TEST_Matrimonio" salvato', creates template-1 with a PNG thumbnail and the label '9×2.5 cm', and clears the name input. (5) After page reload, template-1 is still listed and templates-empty is hidden. 'Usa' replaces the empty item and restores: image, front text with pos over + bold + align right, back text with italic + align left + color #e6007e, the custom LiberationSerif-Italic font (option '(caricato)' shown, FontFace loaded), fit Adatta, tag on, duplex on, 9x2.5. A second 'Usa' adds item-1. Delete shows a toast, removes the template, and templates-empty comes back. (6) Export with 2 template items: the PDF has 2 pages. PNG gives a zip with fronte.png and retro.png (2480x3508). retro.png contains magenta text and fronte.png the red image + dark front text. (7) Regression OK: multi-image add, sheet-format only in item-0 (A4/A3/32x45/A5), cut-marks toggle (20 lines to 0), duplex with normal items blocked by the toast 'Carica il retro di ogni immagine' until backs are uploaded, then the PDF downloads.
action_items: Optional: wrap onSaveTemplate / onUseTemplate / Templates.del in try/catch with an error toast. Today an IndexedDB failure (private mode, quota exceeded) is an unhandled rejection with no user feedback.
Optional: add a confirmation (or undo toast) before deleting a template.
critical_code_review_comments: db.js open() opens a new IDBDatabase connection on every call and never closes it. Cache the connection promise.

onUseTemplate calls set({duplex:true,width,height}) on the shared params. In a mixed job this forces every item to 9x2.5, and export is then blocked until each normal item gets a back. It is consistent with TagToggle but deserves a UI hint.

drawText auto-fits by width, so a long single line fills the zone and alignment changes are barely visible (only the pad, about 10%). Alignment is clearly noticeable only for short or multi-line text. This is expected behaviour but users may think alignment does nothing.
The template stores item.front.file. Verify that this is the processed file (background replaced with white) and not the raw upload, so that the restored image matches what was saved.
Font names are still not sanitized for quotes (carried over from iteration_3).
seed_data_creation: Temp PNGs in /tmp/ttag (red.png 400x300, blue.png 300x300). Template TEST_Matrimonio was created and then deleted (IndexedDB in the browser test context only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Testids: item-N-front-txt-*/item-N-back-txt-* (textarea, font, color, font-upload, font-input, bold, italic, align-left/center/right), item-N-front-txt-pos-left/over, item-N-template-name, item-N-template-save, template-{id}, template-{id}-use, template-{id}-delete, templates-empty. Active toggles have class border-[#E6007E]. Preview tiles are data URLs in the <image> elements of sheet-preview-front/back. Decode one to a canvas and count dark/red pixels to check placement. The export button can be found by the text 'Genera e scarica'; format buttons by the text PNG/JPG.
